title: Install Git
summary: Git saves snapshots of your project so you can undo and collaborate.

steps.instruction: Download Git for Windows from https://git-scm.com/download/win and run the installer. The defaults are fine.
steps.expectedResult: Git is installed. Git Bash appears in the Start menu.

steps.instruction: Open a new terminal and confirm Git is on your PATH.
Set the name that will appear on your commits. Use your real name.
steps.expectedResult: The command prints nothing. That is success.

steps.instruction: Set the email that will appear on your commits.
steps.expectedResult: Again, no output means it worked. Check with git config --global --list.
